  • Vapi Discorddiscord.com

    Large TTS, voice cloning, and Conversational AI community with daily help threads.

    STT/TTS/Voice Agent API support and build-with-us threads.

  • Reddit: r/LocalLLaMAreddit.com

    Active threads on local Whisper/Parakeet, on-device TTS, and end-to-end voice stacks.

  • Reddit: r/AI_Agentsreddit.com

    General AI-agent community where voice topics surface frequently.
